features.observed: Full-size original inspected: four distinct paw ends and long leg shafts, two very large rounded ears, irregular black/tan/white coat patches and full continuous white-tipped tail. Near/far upper forelegs and rear roots partly overlap naturally; the large ear proportions merit biological review. No apparent fifth leg, but exact ownership and native motion are unmeasured.
